title: Closeness from high tester acceptance
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $0\le\varepsilon\le1$, and let $\ell:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$ and $q:\mathbb{F}_2^{n\times n}\to\mathbb{F}_2$. If the quadratic character pair tester accepts the oracle that uses $\ell$ on vectors and $q$ on matrices with probability at least $1-\varepsilon/100$, then there is $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ such that the fraction of inputs on which $\ell(x)$ differs from $\sum_i\gamma_i x_i$ is at most $\varepsilon$, and the fraction of matrices on which $q(B)$ differs from $\sum_{i,j}\gamma_i\gamma_jB_{ij}$ is at most $\varepsilon$. All sums and products in these formulas are in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ maps binary vectors of length $n$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$
The tester's acceptance probability on the oracle formed from $\ell$ and $q$ is at least $1-\varepsilon/100$
